EARTH / Landscape, weather & animal signs

Brontomancy.

Historical interpretation of thunder as an omen, often in relation to its time or direction.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Brontomancy
Brontomancia

Divinatory interpretation of thunder.

Brontoscopy
Brontoscopia

A related term for interpreting thunder, often through a calendrical omen system.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

The Etruscan Brontoscopic Calendar is one documented textual framework. The time and weather record describe the event; the calendar records a historically attributed omen meaning.

Earth
SOURCES & CONTEXT
Jean MacIntosh Turfa — The Etruscan Brontoscopic Calendar ↗
FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Choose a historical text or an existing weather record.
  2. Record the date, place and stated thunder event without adding details the source lacks.
  3. Compare the event with the named text’s omen framework and retain the citation.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • A permitted archive page or weather-log image is suitable.
  • For an existing recording, provide time marks and context rather than going outside to obtain storm footage.
